notes.en: Aimed for authentic Renaissance anatomical draftsmanship based strictly on Leonardo's proportions, balancing an articulated engraved study with a bold silhouette that scales down cleanly to a 38px navbar glyph. Structured with a solid gold base, tiered aged-ink etching, open muscular contours, and delicate diagonal hatching. While the dual-pose overlay reads clearly across all scales, the complex intersection where the raised and horizontal arm pairs meet at the shoulder deltoid remains an intricate geometric compromise.
